goal: Implement the run/improvement plugin modes: a run-mode recorder bundle row that projects dsh session events into privacy-safe run records without improvement code in the hot path, and an improvement-mode workbench tool set over the deterministic dal CLI, split by profile layer.

acceptance_criteria.statement: One dsh bundle (@dal/dsh-modes) ships recorder-on/tools-off so run mode records without workbench code and a workbench profile enables the tools row in its own layer.
Run-mode records validate against the run-record schema, carry only digests/counts/codes (no raw prompt, message, argument, or result content), checkpoint on flush, and finalize on disposal.
The improvement tools run only deterministic dal operations (cluster, prepare payload, summarize, branch evaluate, reset status) and expose nothing approval-gated.
The full local gate passes with the plugin packages type-checked and built.

outcome.summary: Run/improvement plugin modes shipped under plugins/: a mode-split bundle with a privacy-safe session recorder and deterministic workbench tools, contract-verified against the dsh runtime source and gate-green.

what_worked: The dsh contract was read from the installed harness source: bundle manifests (dsh.bundle.patch), profile composition, session/event + session/flush durability seams, and the defineTool registration API.
The recorder accumulates counters only on the hot path and writes at durability checkpoints; observer failures are contained by contract.
Structural typing keeps the recorder free of dsh runtime imports; the tools plugin peers resolve from the profile fallback, not from this repo.
Schema constraints (identifier patterns, uri evidence, literal-true required fields) were honored from the first failing run onward.

calls.name: dsh-inspection
calls.purpose: Read the harness plugin/profiles/session/tools contracts from the installed dsh packages.

calls.name: implement-plugins
calls.purpose: Create the @dal/dsh-modes bundle, @dal/dsh-run-record recorder, and @dal/dsh-improve-tools workbench package.

calls.name: docs-update
calls.purpose: Spec DAL-019, README plugin-modes section, ROADMAP workbench tick, requirement evidence.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run the full repository verification gate.

evidence.summary: Eleven focused tests: schema-valid run-record projection with no raw content, flush/dispose checkpoints, malformed-event containment, Cordis wiring, the five-tool registry, cluster/prepare/branch tool executions, and bundle manifest shape.
Bundle patch ships dal-run-record enabled and dal-improve-tools disabled; a workbench profile flips the row in its own layer.
DAL-019 defines the mode split, the recording policy, the deterministic tool boundary, and the approval-gated mounting posture.
Typecheck (root + both plugin packages), build, 122 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed.

uncertainty.statement: The bundle was verified against the installed dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 contracts and unit-tested, but not mounted into a real profile in this task.
uncertainty.resolution: The profile-mount smoke run is a documented human step gated by a separate install_or_mount_plugin approval.

notes: No dsh profile was created or modified and no plugin was mounted; the bundle sources are VCS-owned and any real mount remains a separate approval-gated install_or_mount_plugin operation.
